defect: Aspect-ratio zone candidates were discarded solely because their rounded width/height matched an earlier candidate, before comparing actual component geometry. Equal boxes do not imply equal pin positions, rotations or opposite-face occupancy.
change: In compact mode, retain same-box candidates when their full shape geometry differs. Share the existing rigid-orientation identity predicate: dimensions, top/bottom offsets, primary side, mirrored footprint mapping and effective per-part rotations (absent means zero), ignoring tags. Append distinct same-box arrangements after legacy unrotated offers and bottom alternatives, before subsequent orientation expansion. Existing initial offer prefix is unchanged; later generated indices are not promised unchanged when new candidates actually exist.
implementation_notes: Noncompact mode preserves dimension pruning and avoids constructing shapes that it will discard. Skip incumbent copies when there are no same-box candidates. The append helper owns its incumbent value, preventing vector reallocation from invalidating a borrowed existing element. No new side permission, rotation permission, clearance or acceptance waiver.

tests.coverage: Same-size arrangements differing in top position, bottom position, mirrored footprint identity, rotation and primary face survive. Exact duplicates and absent-versus-zero rotations collapse. Existing prefix and tags remain intact; repeated append is idempotent; an incumbent borrowed from the growing vector remains valid.
tests.negative_control: Restoring dimension-only pruning fails native_pcb_orientation_contracts: equal-box dedup discarded distinct geometry or retained duplicates.

smaller_screen.scope: Initial implementation before helper extraction and copy/alias refinements; no smaller-board gain demonstrated.

limits: Targeted tests and construction screens, not a new full audit/render qualification. No demonstrated size improvement. Timings overlapped tests and are not controlled speed comparisons or historical Python comparisons. Existing hardware-evidence gaps remain.
